# Route with intention

Aamon's cleanest route is not the fastest route. It is the route that keeps concealment timing aligned with the first side-lane overstep.

## Core idea

Start from the side that gives you the stronger level-four reveal into river control. Your first burst window matters more than raw clear speed.
